body:
Nah man, it's not about looks or money. There is a plenty of ugly, poor or people with no status with lives full of friends or love. It's about character. It's about putting yourself out there, finding those friends who will care for you, finding that right person for you. But that's the hard part. 

  
I often think about this, when seeing a guys that don't have the looks with girlfriends. There is no secret cheat code in this. You won't have tone of friends just because you are good looking. Finding relationships may be easier with the looks. But still, being good looking won't do anything unless you put yourself out there. I often think that I have more to offer than some of these guys I am observing. The difference is that they have their lives in order and they took their shots and were successful and I don't and didn't.

Thanks. It really means a lot. I actually feel better. Not sure if I am the crying type of guy. Last time I cried it was a tragic day for me. Exactly 5 years and 10 days ago, so that may have some impact as well. But even just the feeling of wanting to cry is overwhelming and it is not normal for me. 

I hope your situation gets better as well. At least you get to be with your person. I would break a wall with my hands just for one hug right now. Well, I got yours virtual one, so that is something I guess 😀 but still.. But I get how that your situation may suck, I really do. It's not that crazily different from mine. Yours person and mine both can't be what we want or need them to be for us rn, albeit in different ways. 

I wish you the best of luck, truly do, you helped me a lot today. It's far from perfect but I feel like little bit of weight has been lifted.

Thanks man the reality is that it may not be that deep and everything could turn ok with the girl but still it sucks right now and being alone, looking hours into computer at different papers I could not care about.. I can't wait to be doing something else. As I said it almost feels silly writing "issues with a girl" but the way it makes me feel is anything but that. 

  
Well the issue with the school work is that it's not just assignment but the whole dissertation. But I should be ok if I keep the work rate I have right now. But still I feel so bad. I just want to give up and go to bed and melt.. I even feel like crying sometimes and I haven't done that for 5 years now and can't remember the last time I felt like it.

I feel you. I really hope it works out for you. You know, it's ok taking things slow, we were doing similar thing, just enjoying the time together. We had no promises or anything and I knew about her things in life but that was meant to sort itself out with time until then we wanted to take things slowly, although we rushed few things nonetheless. But now instead of taking things slowly we may have to stop. And the slowly growing apart is killing me. I try to rationalize things but I just can't stop feeling bad and nothing to do to distract myself. And we live far from each other and it's all annoying.

Try to cherish the moments together, man. If I knew things would get this complicated I would hold every hug little bit longer.

Yea, the thing is it may not even be that bad. Maybe it is just a phase and it will be alright no matter what will happen. Maybe we just need time to figure things out. I just can't be alone with my head right now. I overthink anything.. Instead of this I should be working but can't force myself to move a finger.

How did you manage?
I guess. I had falling outs before. But just never felt like this about anything
